scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w admin
scripts.typecheck: npm exec -w backend -- tsc --noEmit -p . && npm exec -w web -- tsc --noEmit && npm exec -w admin -- tsc --noEmit
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
